# sherpa-filter-panel

The filter toolbars, as a column.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Wraps | [sherpa-container](sherpa-container.md) |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-filter-panel/sherpa-filter-panel.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-filter-panel/sherpa-filter-panel.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-filter-panel/sherpa-filter-panel.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-filter-panel/sherpa-filter-panel.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-filter-panel/sherpa-filter-panel.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<div style="block-size: 480px"><sherpa-filter-panel data-heading="Filters" open></sherpa-filter-panel></div>
```

`populate()` is given, on `sherpa-filter-panel`:

```json
[
  {
    "scope": "data",
    "label": "Customer records",
    "filters": [
      {
        "id": "plan",
        "label": "Plan",
        "options": [
          {
            "value": "Pro",
            "label": "Pro"
          },
          {
            "value": "Free",
            "label": "Free"
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "available": [
      {
        "id": "region",
        "label": "Region"
      }
    ]
  }
]
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-apply-on` | `change` `input` |  | input: its source applies LIVE, so a value reports while it moves. Set by a bound source. TODO 107 |
| `data-at-default` | boolean |  | the filters already ARE the View's default: "Reset all to default" is inactive. Written by the provider. TODO 231. |
| `data-dirty` | boolean |  |  |
| `data-group-field` | text |  | the group in force. Written by the source; the Group chip shows it. TRAP T-a-panel-follows-the-query-open-or-shut |
| `data-heading` | text | `Filters` | the panel's own title |
| `data-hide-unmatched` | `on` `off` |  | on \| off — the host hides what Limit rules out, when it is on |
| `data-limit-options` | `on` `off` |  | on \| off — the host offers "Limit to matching filters": its ⋮ menu holds the switch. Written by the provider. TODO 178. |
| `data-locked` | boolean |  | the source owns the state — report, never set |
| `data-nothing-to-reset` | boolean |  | nothing is left to clear: Reset is inactive. Written by the provider. TODO 231. |
| `data-pending` | text |  | the FIELDS changed and not yet applied, space-separated. Set by a bound source; each shows Apply and Discard. |
| `data-remote` | boolean |  | its source fetches from outside the data layer, so a change waits for its field's Apply. Set by a bound source. |
| `data-saveable` | boolean |  | the host SAVES filters: the header's Save filters saves every scope under one name, and its `savedSets` fill the Filters menu's Saved section and the Saved chip. TRAP T-saved-filters-are-every-scope |
| `data-saved` | boolean |  | written BY the panel: a saved set is on, so its Saved chip shows |
| `data-sort-direction` | `asc` `desc` `""` |  | the sort in force. Written by the source; the Sort chip shows it. |
| `data-sort-field` | text |  | the sort in force. Written by the source; the Sort chip shows it. |
| `open` | text, native |  | the panel is showing. A host writes it; the panel reports `filter-panel-close` and never hides itself. Where there is no room, the app shell says so. TRAP T-the-panel-is-desktop-only |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `setFieldReading(id: string, given: FieldReading, scope?: string)` | setFieldReading(id, reading) — steer ONE field with a whole reading: what another control set while the panel shows. SILENT, like every steer, and it is that field's last Apply now, so Discard keeps it. A field drawn as one chip — Group, Sort, a date — is left alone. |
| `drawReading(field: string, reading: FieldReading, scope: string)` | drawReading(field, reading, scope) — a bound source tells the panel one field's answer, in the scope that holds it. OPEN OR SHUT: a shut panel that skipped this opened on an old answer, and its next report wrote that answer back over the Query. |
| `drawResults(results: Readonly<Record<string, number>>, scope?: string)` | drawResults(results, scope) — a bound source tells the panel the rows each answer in a scope matches, by field or saved-filter id. A field drawn as ONE chip, and a saved filter's chip, wear it; a field drawn as a run or a body has no one chip, so its HEADER wears it. SILENT. |
| `drawValueResults(results: Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<Record<string, number>>>>, scope: string)` | drawValueResults(results, scope) — a bound source tells the panel the rows each PICKED value matches on its own, by field then value: each chip of a run wears its own count, and one that is not picked wears none. The header keeps the field's. SILENT. Will, TODO 172. |
| `drawPresent(present: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>, scope: string)` | drawPresent(present, scope) — a bound source says what each field's other answers leave in a scope. A value chip they rule out is greyed — refused if off, set aside if on (180); a field's menu greys its rows. A field not named is not limited. |
| `drawOffered(offered: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>>, scope: string)` | drawOffered(offered, scope) — what each serial-set field OFFERS: a value chip it does not is removed, unless it is on. |
| `show()` | Show the panel. Where there is no room for it is the shell's to say. |
| `hide(reason: 'reader' \| 'width' \| 'page' = 'reader')` | EVERY close reports, and says why. The width path called this directly while only the header button emitted, so a narrow window left the panel gone and the host still in panel mode — no toolbars, no panel. |
| `close(reason: 'reader' \| 'width' \| 'page' = 'reader')` | `hide()`, in the spelling every surface keeps. |
| `toggle()` |  |
| `drawScopes(scopes: readonly ScopeDescription[])` | The source draws each scope WHOLE — what it holds and answers, what it may add, how its rows are arranged. A saved filter is one question answered yes or no; a date is one chip, its menu a calendar. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `quick-filter-change` | `{ readings: Record<string, Record<string, FieldReading>>; scope: 'panel'; values: Record<string, Record<string, string[]>> }` | One field changed, or Reset all. |
| `filter-apply` | `{ field: string; id: string; scope: string }` | A changed field's Apply, remote only; with no field, Apply all. |
| `filter-discard` | `{ field: string; id: string; scope: string }` | A changed field's Discard, remote only; with no field, Discard all. |
| `filter-panel-close` | `{ reason: 'page' \| 'reader' \| 'width' }` | It closed. |
| `filter-add` | `{ from: string; ids: string[]; scope: 'view' \| string }` | A REQUEST: the Filters menu committed, or a field sent up or down. |
| `filter-remove` | `{ id: string; scope: string }` | A field's Remove. |
| `group-change` | `{ field: null \| string; scope: string }` | A Group chip or Reset all, with its scope. |
| `sort-change` | `{ direction: 'asc'; field: null \| string; scope: string }` | A Sort chip or Reset all, with its scope. |
| `filters-apply` | `{ id: string }` | A saved set's row was ticked: apply it. |
| `filters-dismiss` |  | The Saved chip's cross, or its row unticked: put back the filters as they were. |
| `filters-save` |  | Save filters: over the set on, else as a new one. |
| `filters-save-as` |  | Save filters as: a new set, by name. |
| `filters-delete` | `{ id: string \| undefined }` | Delete filters: forget the set on. |
| `view-reset` |  | Reset all to default: put back the View's own filters, in every scope. A host may call `preventDefault()` to take it over. |
| `limit-options-change` | `{ on: boolean }` | The ⋮ menu's "Limit to matching filters". |
| `hide-unmatched-change` | `{ on: boolean }` | The ⋮ menu's "Hide unmatching filters", while Limit is on. |
